note: Set A captures the page's real engineering content — the USE-2 10 G.A current-carrying cable note, U.V.-rated cable ties, the ENMA 3R junction box on the side of the house, and the array output to planter equipment (E-206) — while B omits the cable-tie and junction-box facts and invents a copper note ('1. ALL CU') that the page never states. B also calls two string connections 'positive terminal to positive terminal', contradicting the per-module +/- series markings it uses correctly elsewhere, and binds the planter-equipment output to SA2-19 instead of the array/junction-box output. A's faults are a misread gauge ('10 A.G.'), a garbled module-model quote, and several unsupported quantity/identifier claims; both sets over-report the ambiguous '3' callouts.
remarks: Text layer is fragmentary: 'USE-2,10.G.A', 'FRAMLESS GLASS DESIG', and the repeated bare '3' and '11' tokens are detached from their graphics. Per the legend, 11 = #10G bonding jumper; the '3' tokens have no legend entry, so claims treating them as quantity/identifier/value are unsupported or vague in both sets. Both sets miss the #10G bonding jumper legend entry and the WEATHERHEAD element; A additionally garbles the SUNPREME GX290 module/frameless glass design (see E-502) legend text. Per-module polarity mapping (which four modules read '- +') could not be verified from the text layer alone, so single-terminal polarity claims were not penalized.
